name: byfareska/crud
description: Symfony bundle for admin panels: CRUDs from an attribute (Doctrine or DTO + use case drivers), a UI kit of Twig components, dashboards of widgets and a command palette - built on Symfony UX Live Components.

suggest.doctrine/doctrine-bundle: The doctrine driver (CRUD on entities) and dashboard layouts kept in the database
suggest.symfony/security-bundle: The actor of the panel (roles of resources, panels and widgets)
suggest.ext-intl: Accent-insensitive search of the command palette, ICU messages
suggest.symfony/ux-autocomplete: (3.5 or later) Relation filters of the lists searched as you type; widget settings with many choices to search in (the zone of the clock)
suggest.symfony/mime: Uploading files (byfareska_crud.files): what a file is, read from its bytes
suggest.league/flysystem: Storages of uploaded files on a disk, FTP, SFTP, S3... (byfareska_crud.files)
suggest.league/flysystem-bundle: The Flysystem storages as services, to name in byfareska_crud.files.storages
suggest.intervention/image: (4 or later, with ext-imagick - keeps the colour profile of a photo - or ext-gd) The sizes of uploaded images: thumbnails of the lists, sizes of rich text (byfareska_crud.files.images)
suggest.symfony/asset-mapper: The panel's script through the application's importmap, with its Symfony UX controllers (byfareska_crud.assets: auto, the default, with symfony/stimulus-bundle)
suggest.symfony/reprise: The assets of the panel built by Vite with the application's own (byfareska_crud.assets: reprise); or Webpack Encore, AssetMapper's importmap
